title: Mohabbat
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the difference between Mohabbat & Ishq & the difficulties arising in loving someone. Love is when you're thoughtful of the other person's likes & wants.

title: Intezaar
desc: Javed Akhtar says you either wait for the one you love or you wait for some worldly affairs with a hope for a better tomorrow.

title: Ummeed Aarzu
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about hope of finishing a work, hope of meeting someone, hope of achieving dreams. He says you will lose the day you stop hoping & trying.

title: Wafa
desc: Javed Akhtar tells how poets have always given priority to loyalty over love in their writings. Loyalty is the most important thing in every relationship.

title: Dil
desc: Javed Akhtar says the hero of any Urdu shayari is neither lover nor beauty nor even love, it is always the heart. He says in different situations the heart responds differently.

title: Deewana
desc: Javed Akhtar says some people are in love with either their work or a person or some motive or a goal. Sometimes passion in your love is necessary to be able to achieve what you want.
